name: Kitaoji Yuzuki
source: Actor of the moment, Yuzuki is the star of the year's most popular movies and has a part on an award- winning primetime TV show. Hailing from an illustrious family, Yuzuki is the son of a business mogul and ex-model. You can expect to meet Yuzuki's brother, Satsuki, as he opens Japan's first legal casino in the chic Roppongi district of Tokyo.
